response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, t.telescregistry AS telescregistry, t.bandusagepct AS bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM filtered GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS mean_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_band AS avg_bandusagepct, p.telescope_count, p.avg_band - ov.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE ov.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
